title: Dynamic Token Merging for Efficient Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27064v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) represent each image with hundreds of visual tokens, which can make inference costly even when a prompt depends on only part of the image. Dynamic Token Merging (DTM), introduced in MrT5 for byte-level text encoders, learns which tokens to remove: a lightweight delete gate scores contextualized hidden states, acts as a differentiable attention bias during training, and physically removes tokens at inference. We argue that DTM is a general token deletion framework rather than a byte-level technique, and extend it to the vision modality and to decoder-only models. Applying DTM to T5Gemma 2 and Gemma 3 yields V-MrT5Gemma2, which deletes visual tokens inside a bidirectional multimodal encoder, and V-MrGemma3, which compacts the prompt and its key-value caches during decoder-only prefill. translated_title: 面向高效视觉-语言模型的动态标记合并
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）使用数百个视觉标记来表示每张图像，这使得即使提示仅依赖于图像的一部分，推理成本也可能很高。动态标记合并（DTM）最初在 MrT5 中针对字节级文本编码器提出，它学习应该删除哪些标记：一个轻量级的删除门对上下文化的隐藏状态进行评分，在训练期间充当可微分的注意力偏置，并在推理时物理地删除标记。作者论证 DTM 是一个通用的标记删除框架，而非一种字节级技术，并将其扩展到视觉模态和仅解码器模型。将 DTM 应用于 T5Gemma 2 和 Gemma 3，得到了 V-MrT5Gemma2（在双向多模态编码器内部删除视觉标记）和 V-MrGemma3（在仅解码器的预填充阶段压缩提示及其键值缓存）。在十个基准测试中，DTM 相对于基于注意力的删除和随机删除的优势随删除率的增加而增长，并在（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将 MrT5 中的动态标记合并（DTM）推广为通用的标记删除框架，扩展至视觉模态与仅解码器模型，通过自适应删除视觉标记并压缩键值缓存来显著降低视觉-语言模型的推理成本。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Dynamic Token Merging (DTM) from byte-level text encoders into a general token deletion framework for the vision modality and decoder-only models, adaptively pruning visual tokens and compacting key-value caches to substantially reduce VLM inference costs.
